title: The Reset
long_description:
Information
On-stage tickets available. The RESET sound experience is an immersive sound healing, meditation, and restoration event created by singer-songwriter Davin Youngs. It combines improvised vocals, loop devices, electronic beats, and overtone-emitting instruments to create a modern sound bath designed for deep relaxation and emotional release. STAGE: Stage Seating: Join the artist for an immersive on-stage experience. Guests must bring their own yoga mats and blankets. 1) Stage Seating Only 2) Standard Admission: Stage Seating, + access to pre-event yoga class ORCH & BALC: Traditional theater-style seating in Orchestra and Balcony

Accessibility
ADA and ADA Companion seating is available throughout the venue. Please use the dropdown above to select the desired seat types.

Note: 
On-stage tickets available. The RESET sound experience is an immersive sound healing, meditation, and restoration event created by singer-songwriter Davin Youngs. It combines improvised vocals, loop devices, electronic beats, and overtone-emitting instruments to create a modern sound bath designed for deep relaxation and emotional release. This event offers the choice of traditional audience seating or a rare on-stage experience with the artist. Elevate your evening with a 45-minute gentle yoga session led by Newark Yoga Movement in the Chase Room at 6:30 PM - an intentional bridge to prepare your body for the stillness and resonance that follows. Guests must bring their own yoga mats. None will be provided. Late seating is not permitted on the stage. Audience seating does not accommodate for yoga mats, but allows for an immersive sound experience.

Ticket Limit
There is an overall 8 ticket limit for this event.
